delivery.title: Imininingwane Yekuletsa - {{id}}
delivery.passExplainer: I "Pass" lapha kusho kuphela kutsi iseva lecondziwe ibuyisele simo se HTTP 2xx - akucinisekisi kutsi luhlelo lwekwemukela lugcinwe mbamba noma lwacubungula umholi. Hlola umtimba wemphendvulo longenhla kutsi utsini mbamba; uma ngabe kungenalutfo noma nje kuvuma, lolo hlelo kungenteka kutsi lutfola sicelo kepha lulahla noma lunganaki umtfwalo wekukhokha ngekhatsi (emagama ensimu/ifomethi lengakalungi ye API yayo , insimu ledzingekako eceleni kwayo kutsi lomtfwalo wekukhokha awufaki, njll).

push.title: Webhooks Laphumako - Kuphusha Kuhola & Tibuyeketo
push.intro: Ingaguculwa ngalokuphelele nge- webhook : JSON , Lifomu (x-www-lifomu-urlencoded), noma ithempulethi yakho yemtimba weMkhuba lene <fieldkey></fieldkey> tibambo tendzawo (sib. <example></example> ) - isebenta njengekugcwalisa umyalo cURL kanye.
push.curlLabel: Namatsisela i cURL ye CRM yeklayenti lakho
push.curlHelp: Namatsisela sibonelo sicelo API yabo docs noma Postman akunika (ngedatha yangempela noma isampula). URL , indlela kanye netinhloko kukopishwa njengobe-kunjalo, futsi yonkhe ikhiye emtimbeni ibhalwe ngezansi kute ukhone kukhetsa kutsi nguyiphi insimu CRM leyigcwalisa kumholi ngamunye.
push.curlPrompt: Ingabe cURL yeklayenti ? <action>Ngenisa kusuka cURL</action> kugcwalisa loku kanye nemasimu emabalave ngekuzenzakalela.
push.urlVariables: I URL ingacuketse tintfo letigucukako futsi, sibonelo <urlexample></urlexample> .
push.headersInvalid: Tinhloko kumele tibe JSON levumelekile , sibonelo {{example}}
push.authTitle: Kucinisekisa (indlela Leadrat ingena ngayo ku API yabo )
push.modeSame: Tfumela wonkhe umcimbi ku URL lefanako
push.modeCreateUpdate: Dala irekhodi kanye, bese uvuselela lelo rekhodi lelifanako (kute letiphindvwe kabili eceleni kwabo)
push.responseIdHint: Lapho ID ku JSON yabo imphendvulo yesicelo sekudala. Kugcinwe ngekuhola ngamunye njenge <externalid></externalid> .
push.retriesHint: Kute kuphele sikhatsi, emaphutsa e HTTP 429 kanye ne-5xx - ngemuva kwemizuzu lengu-1, imizuzu lengu-5, imizuzu lengu-30, 2 h, 6 h.
push.howFilled: Indlela emanani agcwaliswa ngayo: le webhook iphindze isetjentiswe kuwo wonkhe umholi - Leadrat ayitfumeli sibonelo lesimile, itfumela kuphusha lokusha ngaso sonkhe sikhatsi lapho kwenteka khona umcimbi lokhetsiwe, ngemanani lamanje e-THAT lead.
push.howFilledStandard: JSON / Ifomu ngekuzenzakalela kufaka yonkhe insimu ku-lead - kute lokusetha.
push.howFilledCustom: Custom - bhala umtimba wakho wesicelo bese ufaka noma ngukuphi; ngamunye ushintjwa ngenani langempela lalelo lead ngaphambi nje kwekutfumela. Chafata lokugucukako lokungezansi kute ukufake.

receive.title: Tfola - Yemukela imikhondo nganoma nguyiphi indlela
receive.intro: Umtfombo ngamunye utfola URL yawo . Khomba tikhangiso letiholako Facebook , Zapier , lifomu lewebhusayithi noma lenye webhook ye- CRM kuyo - batfumela imikhondo nge JSON yabo noma ngendlela yefomu, bese ubeka emabalave emasimu abo kuwe.
receive.urlIntro: URL yakho yekutfola - nika loku eluhlelweni lwekutfumela ( POST , JSON noma lifomu-lekhodiwe):

receive.sendExample: Tfumela sibonelo sinye kucala - sitsatfwa njengesampula (kute lokungeniswako kuze kube ngulapho imephu lengentansi igcinwa).
receive.sampleLabel: Sibonelo semtfwalo wekukhokha (namatsisela munye, noma ushiye lutfo kute usebentise sicelo sekugcina lesitfoliwe)

Tfumela ukhiye enhloko ye <hdr></hdr> , njenge <bearer></bearer> , noma (uma lithulusi lingakhoni kusetha tinhloko) njenge <query></query> . Umkhawulo: {{limit}} ticelo ngemzuzu.
